article_title: Bylaw 14840 — Density Bonus Reserve Fund Bylaw
body:
Bylaw No. 14840 
CITY OF BURNABY 
 
BYLAW NO. 14840 
 
A BYLAW to establish the Density Bonus Reserve Fund 
 
The Council of the City of Burnaby ENACTS as follows: 
 
1. 
This Bylaw may be cited as BURNABY DENSITY BONUS RESERVE FUND 
BYLAW, 2026. 
 
2. 
Pursuant to section 188 of the Community Charter, Council hereby establishes the Density 
Bonus Reserve Fund to receive and hold funds for the purpose of the capital costs of 
conserving or providing amenities. 
 
3. 
Money deposited into the Density Bonus Reserve Fund, together with interest earned on it, 
may be used and expended solely for the capital costs of conserving or providing amenities. 
 
 
 
Read a first time this 28th day of July, 2026 
Read a second time this 28th day of July, 2026 
Read a third time this 28th day of July, 2026 
Reconsidered and adopted this 25th day of August, 2026 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
MAYOR 
 
 
 
 
 
 
DEPUTY CORPORATE OFFICER 
Signed Original Bylaw on file.

minutes_briefs.title: Burnaby creates Density Bonus Reserve Fund for developer amenity payments
minutes_briefs.summary: The City of Burnaby has passed a new bylaw that sets up a special reserve fund to hold money paid by developers when they build more than the usual allowed density (how much can be built on a piece of land). This money can only be used to pay for the capital costs (major one-time expenses like building or upgrading) of community amenities, such as parks, community centres, or other public facilities. The fund was officially established on August 25, 2026, and any interest earned on the money will also be used for these purposes.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you are a developer or property owner planning a project with extra density, be aware that any required density bonus payments will now go into this dedicated fund.
